decisions.reason: Selecting beige as the primary color does not change the existing DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The color selection does not change the machine name or retained wording requirements.
The beige color decision does not alter bowl capacity or form; the separate bowl-size clause in the same message is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
Changing the design's primary color does not affect spout geometry, location, or barista-facing orientation.
The color choice is owned by the visual color-scheme Requirement and does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
The beige color selection has no effect on the electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
The primary color choice does not change the required mixing quality or foam consistency.
The beige color selection does not alter the splash-control behavior.
The color decision does not change valve operation, drip prevention, or controlled flow behavior.
The design color does not affect plumbing seals or liquid-containment requirements.
The beige color choice does not change fluid-path cleaning or removability requirements.
